rules.effective_date_basis: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
rules.title: Santa Ana annual rent increase cap
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are capped at the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the CPI change over the most recent 12 months. If CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted, and owners may petition for relief to obtain a fair and reasonable return.
rules.key_value: Lower of 3% per year or 80% of CPI; 0% if CPI is negative

coverage.other_unresolvable: Mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990 are not covered.
coverage.summary: Applies to covered residential rental buildings constructed on or before February 1, 1995, and covered mobile home spaces offered for rent on or before January 1, 1990.

rules.exemptions: The rent cap does not apply to residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or to mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

rules.law_name: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.effective_date_basis: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
rules.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction protections
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, an owner may not terminate a tenancy without just cause stated in a written notice. For no-fault just cause terminations, the owner must provide three months of relocation assistance or waive rent for the final three months of the tenancy.
rules.key_value: Just cause required after 30 days; 3 months relocation assistance or rent waiver for no-fault termination

coverage.other_unresolvable: Exemptions include deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
coverage.summary: Applies to covered residential tenancies after 30 days, excluding housing produced in the last 15 years and specified institutional, transient, affordable, dormitory, and shared living arrangements.

rules.exemptions: The ordinance does not apply to certain types of residential property, including housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
